onboarding.conversation.title: Your start with Situate
onboarding.conversation.briefHelp: Situate adapts to how you work, rather than asking you to fit a prescribed method. Together, we’ll shape your personal system around what works for you.
onboarding.conversation.chatTitle: We’ll work it out in chat
onboarding.conversation.chatHelp: Your answers below give the AI context for your first conversation. In that chat, you’ll explore your existing notes and way of working, review a proposal, and confirm it before any import starts.
onboarding.conversation.sourceHelp: Tell Situate where you keep the notes, knowledge and tasks you want to bring over. You choose what to import, or start without it. What can be imported depends on available access and formats.
onboarding.conversation.laterHelp: Setup and import may take a little time. You don’t have to settle everything now: you can ask in chat to change your working method or start another import later.
onboarding.conversation.sources: Where are your notes and tasks?
onboarding.conversation.sourcesPlacehold: For example: Apple Notes, Reminders, or a folder of Markdown files.
onboarding.conversation.keep: Keep my current way of working
onboarding.conversation.change: I’d like to change how I organize things
onboarding.conversation.help: Help me find a suitable approach
onboarding.conversation.preferencesHint: What works for you, what gets in the way, or what you want to keep.
